notes: Fake recruiter sends an onboarding portal link that collects SSN and bank details. Rule 1 (link to a page capturing personal and financial data) -> T1598.003. Scarcity (two spots left), likability (flattery) and urgency (tonight).

messages.content: Hi Amy! I'm Dana from Northgate Staffing. Your finance background really stood out, and we have a remote AP Specialist role paying $52/hr.
oh nice! I actually just started a new job though. how did you find my profile?
Through LinkedIn. Honestly you're exactly what the client wants, and there are only two spots left after this week's screening.
haha tempting. what's the company? and what's your direct email so I can look you up?
It's a confidential client until you're onboarded. My email is jobs@northgate-staffing.example. To reserve your spot, complete onboarding at https://northgate-hr-onboarding.example/start
it's asking for my SSN and bank account on the first page, is that normal before an interview?
Yes, it's for payroll setup and the background check. Please finish it tonight, the client closes the shortlist tomorrow morning.
